avis.titre: It works, but there are MUCH better options
avis.texte: I had a deluxe sample of this product that lasted me a week. I used it consistently every day until it ran out. It was 5mL or .16 Fl oz. Let me tell you: I am quite familiar with BHAs and Salicylic acid. I am acne prone and have been my whole life. I have found my HGs and I don't stray far from them. This was effective, but it was not as gentle as I would have wanted. Some days, my open wounds (pimples) burned after applying. It was still on the gentler side though as my skin is very sensitive. It works, but there are products that function similarly, without the high price point. Trust me, I don't mind at all paying for an effective product. However, when you can find products that work just as well for 1/3 of the price point, then why bother? The BIGGEST issue with this product was the SMELL. The stench, I should say. It smells odd and I couldn't ignore it. Every single time I put this on my face, I noticed how gross it smelt. I was looking through reviews and was surpised that wasn't a main mention. It smells like spit or something that has been fermenting. No clue what to pinpoint the fragrance, but I would leave it alone, just for that. I finished the product for review sake and because I was traveling. I recommend getting something else. Save your money. Save your nostrils. There are amazing, more effective, more gentle BHA exfoliators out there.

avis.titre: This is a really great product!
avis.texte: I was fortunate enough to receive this from BzzAgent to try and provide my honest review. Although I'll be approaching my 40s in a few years, I still struggle with adult and hormonal acne. I've tried lots of and lots of other acne medications including tretinoin which would leave my face raw and dry regardless if I used it once a week. I have combo/oily skin and large pores on my nose. I have been using this Vichy BHA exfoliating serum once every few days...usually at night, but if I use a retinol at night I'll use this in the morning....just make sure you wear a spf! I have notice a big improvement in the clarity of my skin including my pores looking more clean. This hasn't dried my skin out or irritated it and seems to be a gentle formula as my skin can be sensitive. You only need a couple of drops to cover your entire face and neck. This doesn't appear to have a strong fragrance in it if any and is easily absorbed in the skin. The only reason I took of 1 star is because denatured alcohol is the second or third ingredient which can dry my skin out and make it more oily which is why I don'tuse this product daily. I do try to avoid products with denatured alcohol in it. Overall I will keep using this as it has helped with my acne, pores and skin texture and plan on purchasing it once I use this. As long as I use it every few days I haven't had issues with my skin getting fry/flaky or increasing my oil production!
I don't see any majors differences between this product and the drugstore brands that I use. I thought j would see better results in a smaller time frame but it does about the same.
